name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.XWE.folded_cut_asymmetric
title: Independent budgets for public transitions, functional keys and challenge ciphertexts
statement: For uniform s-bit public cuts, give separate exponent caps e to public transition calls, k to keys and h to attribute ciphertexts. When s fits the public and key caps, a pure split exists exactly when m+(j+1)s is at most (j+1)e+k+h.
